text: おんせんで　からだを　なおすことを　とうじ　って　いうんだぞ

structure.jp: おんせんで　からだを　なおすことを
structure.en: healing your body at a hot spring

structure.jp: とうじ　って　いうんだぞ

patterns.name: 〜という (naming)
patterns.span: とうじ　って　いう
patterns.explanation: A を B と いう means 'A is called B'. って is the casual spoken form of と. とうじ　って　いう = 'it is called tōji'.

patterns.name: 〜こと (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: こと after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing' in English. なおすこと = 'healing'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken short form of のだ and gives the feel of explaining something. ぞ is a rough, manly 'I'm telling you'. いうんだぞ = 'it's called that, you know'.
